pageDescription: Convert .env files to JSON and JSON back to .env with this free online converter. Paste a dotenv file to get a clean JSON object of your environment variables — quotes, comments, the export prefix and values containing = are all handled correctly — or paste a JSON object to generate a ready-to-use .env file with proper quoting. Everything runs locally in your browser, so secrets and API keys are never uploaded. Ideal for developers wiring up config, importing variables into CI, or moving settings between formats.

troubleshooting: No variables found: check the lines use KEY=value, not KEY: value
Invalid JSON error: JSON → .env needs a valid JSON object
Value lost a comment: that's expected — comments aren't part of the value
Quotes look different: the parser normalizes quoting on output
Array rejected: .env needs an object of key/value pairs, not an array
